en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Abu Dawood Al Mustariq, from Muhassin Al Maysami, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic does not Transfer a servant from the disgrace of the disobedience to the honour of the piety except He<sup>azwj</sup> would Enrich him from without wealth, and Honour him from without a clan, and Give him companionship from without a person’.
en.sarwar: 8. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu’ alia ibn Muhammad from abu Dawud al-Mustariqq from Muhsin al-Maythami from Ya’qub ibn Shu’ayb who has said the following:

“I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, does not transfer a believer from the humiliation of sins to the honor of piety before granting him freedom from wants without property, strength without tribesmen and comforting companionship without people.’”
